classes.name: Entity
classes.comment: Most general CAC spine class. Do not instantiate directly.

classes.name: EnduringEntity
classes.comment: Persists through time: people, orgs, devices, artifacts, places, results.

classes.name: Occurrent
classes.comment: Things that happen or unfold in time. Do not instantiate directly.

classes.name: Event
classes.comment: Action, interaction, incident, hearing, or process step.

classes.name: Situation
classes.comment: A context or configuration that holds at a time. Aligned to gUFO Situation.

classes.name: Role
classes.comment: Non-rigid capacity borne by an enduring entity. Aligned to gUFO Role and UCO Role.

classes.name: Phase
classes.comment: Temporal stage of an entity, process, or situation. Aligned to gUFO Phase.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: UcoThing
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: Root of the UCO class hierarchy (disjoint from UcoType in 1.5.0).

uco_core_hierarchy.name: UcoObject
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: Identified characterization of a concept. Parent of most instance classes.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: Facet
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: Duck-typed property bundle attached via hasFacet. Never a top-level evidence item.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: Item
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: A distinct object that can be characterized by Facets.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: Relationship
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: Directed or undirected association between UcoObjects.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: UcoType
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: Metaclass anchor added in UCO 1.5.0; disjoint from UcoThing.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: ObservableObject
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: Cyber-observable evidence carrier. Compose via hasFacet.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: Action
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: Something that is done. Parent of InvestigativeAction.

uco_core_hierarchy.name: InvestigativeAction
uco_core_hierarchy.comment: A discrete investigative step with instrument, object, and result.

facet_pattern.rule: One host per real-world thing; many Facets. Facets are never top-level evidence items.
